title: UI-Genie: A Self-Improving Approach for Iteratively Boosting MLLM-based Mobile GUI Agents
authors_zh: Han Xiao、Guozhi Wang、Yuxiang Chai、Zimu Lu、Weifeng Lin、Hao He、Lue Fan、Liuyang Bian、Rui Hu、Liang Liu、Shuai Ren、Yafei Wen、Xiaoxin Chen、Aojun Zhou、Hongsheng Li
paper_type_zh: 移动 GUI 奖励数据与迭代式 agent 数据构造配方
best_for_zh: 关注多模态 GUI agent、奖励模型、轨迹筛选、自改进数据闭环及发布审计的研究者
one_line: Builds mobile-GUI reward data from rule checks, controlled corruptions, and mined hard negatives, then uses a learned verifier to collect step-level agent SFT data over three rounds.
以规则核验、受控破坏和困难负例构造移动 GUI 奖励数据，再用学习到的验证器在三轮探索中筛选步级 agent SFT 数据。
why: Makes an iterative verifier-guided mobile-agent data engine inspectable while exposing count drift, verifier feedback loops, privacy, licensing, and replay risks.
inclusion_reason: Releases binary GUI reward examples and accepted agent action data together with a controlled-corruption, hard-negative, and iterative reward-guided construction recipe.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Mobile GUI agents need supervision for both local action correctness and whole-task completion, yet dynamic execution is expensive and reference trajectories admit only a narrow set of valid behaviors. Static imitation data alone does not say whether an alternative click is harmless, whether a later state completes the instruction, or whether an apparently successful action caused an unwanted side effect. UI-Genie asks whether a learned multimodal verifier can turn existing demonstrations and new device exploration into additional reward-model and agent-training data.

The relevant data objects are not just “trajectories.” They include binary step/task reward examples built from screenshots, action history, candidate actions, rule labels, controlled corruptions, and mined hard negatives, plus successful exploration steps formatted for agent SFT. Auditing therefore requires separating source demonstrations, synthetic negatives, explored trajectories, verifier decisions, and the final released row/trajectory units.

移动 GUI agent 同时需要局部动作正确性与整项任务完成度的监督，但动态执行成本高，参考轨迹又只覆盖少量有效行为。仅靠静态模仿数据，无法判断替代点击是否无害、后续界面是否已经满足指令，也无法发现表面成功的动作是否带来不期望的副作用。UI-Genie 研究的问题是：能否用一个学习得到的多模态验证器，把既有示范和新的设备探索转化为更多奖励模型数据与 agent 训练数据。

这里的数据对象并不只是“轨迹”。它还包括由截图、动作历史、候选动作、规则标签、受控破坏和困难负例构成的二元步级/任务级奖励样本，以及被判定成功后用于 agent SFT 的探索步骤。因此，审计时必须区分源示范、合成负例、探索轨迹、验证器决策与最终发布中的行数/轨迹数口径。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
UI-Genie-RM casts both action evaluation and task completion as next-token prediction of special positive/negative tokens. Its input combines the task goal, current screenshot, candidate action, the five most recent screenshots, and a textual summary of earlier actions; task completion is represented as a special action so one model can score step and outcome examples.

Initial reward data comes from AndroidControl, AMEX, and AndroidLab. Positives are checked against action type, click/long-press coordinates inside the reference bounding box, or typing semantics. Negatives come from controlled trajectory corruption and from examples that an initial RM incorrectly accepts. The learned RM then scores 10 candidate actions per exploration step, ranks paths by cumulative reward, keeps five beams, verifies completed trajectories, and helps assign new step labels through five continuation trials.

The scale labels need qualification. Paper Table 1 reports nominal RM components of 263K AndroidControl, 170K AMEX, 24K AndroidLab, and 59K exploration examples, while the current Hub viewer exposes 472,769 RM rows. For UI-Genie-Agent-16k, the same table reports size 16K, average 7.1 steps, and 2,208 trajectories. The Hub repository contains 16,693 screenshot files organized under 2,208 trajectory directories and a 74.35 MB ui_genie_agent_16k.jsonl; “16k” is therefore a step/example-scale name, not evidence of 16,000 distinct trajectories.

UI-Genie-RM 把动作评估和任务完成判断统一为特殊 positive/negative token 的下一 token 预测。输入包括任务目标、当前截图、候选动作、最近五张截图，以及对更早动作的文本摘要；任务完成被表示为一种特殊动作，因此同一模型可以处理步级与结果级样本。

初始奖励数据来自 AndroidControl、AMEX 和 AndroidLab。正例通过动作类型、点击/长按坐标是否落入参考边界框、或输入文本的语义一致性来核验；负例来自受控轨迹破坏，以及被初始 RM 错误接受的样本。学习后的 RM 在每个探索步骤为 10 个候选动作打分，按累计奖励排序并保留 5 条 beam，再核验完整轨迹；对新步骤，还通过 5 次续跑试验辅助赋予标签。

规模名称需要加以限定。论文表 1 给出的名义 RM 构成为 AndroidControl 263K、AMEX 170K、AndroidLab 24K 和探索数据 59K，但当前 Hub viewer 实际暴露 472,769 行 RM 数据。对于 UI-Genie-Agent-16k，同一张表写的是规模 16K、平均 7.1 步、共 2,208 条轨迹。Hub 仓库中有 16,693 张截图，按 2,208 个轨迹目录组织，并包含一个 74.35 MB 的 ui_genie_agent_16k.jsonl；因此“16k”应理解为步/样本规模名称，不能据此宣称存在 16,000 条不同轨迹。

title: Method
方法
html:
The initial RM set is built in two branches. Rule-based verification checks source actions by type, spatial grounding, and typed-text semantics. Controlled trajectory corruption creates outcome negatives by early truncation, replacing part of a trajectory with actions from another task in the same app, or continuing redundantly after completion. For hard negatives, AMEX UI-element annotations are converted by DeepSeek-V3 from functional descriptions into executable action descriptions; samples misclassified as positive by an initial RM are retained as difficult negatives.

Exploration uses reward-guided beam search. At each state the current agent proposes 10 actions; UI-Genie-RM supplies step rewards, paths are ranked by cumulative reward, and the top five continue. UI-Genie-RM also judges whether a completed trajectory succeeded. Successful trajectories become agent SFT data and contribute positive reward steps. For a step in a failed trajectory, the pipeline samples five continuations: if any reaches success, the original step is labeled positive; otherwise it is treated as negative. This is a model-mediated label contract, not an independently adjudicated environment truth for every record.

Three rounds broaden tasks. Round 1 uses instructions from AndroidLab and AMEX training data. Round 2 asks DeepSeek-V3 to generate novel instructions from app descriptions and first-round examples. Round 3 revisits failed instructions and adds manually crafted scenarios requiring more than 10 steps. Thus the paper's “without manual annotation” claim concerns synthetic trajectory labeling; it does not mean zero human input, because source demonstrations and manually authored complex task prompts remain in the pipeline.

The paper trains the 7B RM on 458K initial plus 59K exploration examples with AdamW, learning rate 1e-5, and global batch 160. The 7B agent is iteratively continued for one epoch after each round; 3B is fully fine-tuned, while 72B uses RSLoRA (rank 64, alpha 256, PiSSA initialization). The released repository contains 3B/7B/72B agent SFT scripts and AndroidControl evaluation code, but not the end-to-end corruption, hard-negative mining, RM training, beam-search exploration, or dynamic AndroidLab/Android Arena execution pipeline.

初始 RM 数据由两条分支构成。规则核验按动作类型、空间定位和输入文本语义检查源动作。受控轨迹破坏通过提前截断、用同一 app 中另一任务的动作替换部分轨迹、或在任务完成后继续执行冗余动作来制造结果级负例。困难负例分支先利用 AMEX 的 UI 元素标注，再让 DeepSeek-V3 把功能描述改写为可执行动作描述；被初始 RM 错判为正的样本会被保留为困难负例。

探索采用奖励引导的 beam search。当前 agent 在每个状态提出 10 个动作，UI-Genie-RM 给出步级奖励，系统按累计奖励排序并让前 5 条路径继续。UI-Genie-RM 还判断完整轨迹是否成功。成功轨迹进入 agent SFT，并贡献正的奖励步骤。对于失败轨迹中的某一步，流程采样 5 条续跑路径：只要其中一条成功，原步骤就标为正，否则按负例处理。这是一种由模型中介的标签契约，并非每条记录都由独立环境真值裁决。

三轮迭代逐步扩展任务。第一轮直接使用 AndroidLab 与 AMEX 训练数据中的指令；第二轮让 DeepSeek-V3 根据 app 描述和第一轮示例生成新指令；第三轮重试失败指令，并加入人工编写、需要超过 10 步的复杂场景。因此，论文所称“without manual annotation”针对的是合成轨迹的标注，不代表流程没有人工输入，因为源示范与人工编写的复杂任务提示仍在其中。

论文用 458K 条初始样本和 59K 条探索样本训练 7B RM，采用 AdamW、1e-5 学习率和全局 batch 160。7B agent 每轮之后继续训练 1 个 epoch；3B 使用全参数微调，72B 使用 RSLoRA（rank 64、alpha 256、PiSSA 初始化）。发布仓库包含 3B/7B/72B agent SFT 脚本和 AndroidControl 评测代码，但没有端到端的受控破坏、困难负例挖掘、RM 训练、beam-search 探索，也没有动态 AndroidLab/Android Arena 执行流程。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On the authors' custom RM benchmark, UI-Genie-RM reports overall F1 of 79.6 for step evaluation and 82.1 for outcome evaluation. That benchmark samples positives from AndroidControl, AMEX, and AndroidLab and constructs negatives with agent errors or trajectory corruption, so it tests the proposed contract but is close to the training sources and negative-generation mechanisms. It is not an independent audit of all released labels.

For agents, the paper reports AndroidControl success rates of 93.8/72.9 (low/high) for 3B, 94.3/74.2 for 7B, and 94.8/77.0 for 72B. Dynamic AndroidLab success is 28.8, 38.7, and 41.2 respectively. On Android Arena, the 7B model reports 20.4 functional success, 24.4 LLM-judged success, and 51.4 ESAR; both functional and LLM-judged success are 0.0 for the hard and multi-frame-query subsets. These results show that the training pipeline changes agent behavior, not that every synthetic example is correct.

The ablation supports the history/unification choices: five-image unified RM input reaches 79.6 step and 82.1 outcome F1, versus 61.3/60.5 without history. The gain is not uniform—hard step F1 is 68.7 with five images versus 71.5 with three. Best-of-10 inference also gives modest or absent hard-task improvements, including 7B hard task success staying at 1.4 and hard step score dropping from 61.1 to 58.9.

Release evidence is partial but concrete. The RM Hub repository has one 2.16 GB JSONL and 472,769 viewer rows with fields messages, images, and positive. The Agent repository has a 74.35 MB UI-Genie JSONL, 16,693 screenshots in 2,208 trajectory directories, and an additional 155.55 MB AMEX_Agent_34K.jsonl whose relationship to the named release is undocumented. The NeurIPS supplemental archive contains only three demonstration trajectories with screenshots, XML states, and history JSON; it is illustrative, not a full construction package.

在作者自建的 RM benchmark 上，UI-Genie-RM 报告的总体 F1 为：步级评估 79.6、结果级评估 82.1。该 benchmark 从 AndroidControl、AMEX 和 AndroidLab 抽取正例，并用 agent 错误或轨迹破坏构造负例，因此它能检验论文提出的标签契约，但与训练来源和负例生成机制较为接近，不能视为对全部发布标签的独立审计。

在 agent 评测中，论文报告的 AndroidControl 成功率为：3B 的 low/high 分别是 93.8/72.9，7B 为 94.3/74.2，72B 为 94.8/77.0；动态 AndroidLab 成功率分别为 28.8、38.7 和 41.2。Android Arena 上，7B 模型的 functional success、LLM-judged success 和 ESAR 分别为 20.4、24.4 和 51.4；在 hard 与 multi-frame-query 子集上，前两种成功率都为 0.0。这些结果表明训练流程改变了 agent 行为，但不能证明每条合成样本都正确。

消融实验支持历史上下文和统一建模的选择：使用五张图并统一建模时，RM 的步级/结果级 F1 为 79.6/82.1，无历史时为 61.3/60.5。不过增益并不均匀；hard 步级 F1 在五图设置下为 68.7，低于三图设置的 71.5。best-of-10 推理对困难任务的改善也有限或不存在，例如 7B 的 hard task success 仍为 1.4，hard step 分数还从 61.1 降到 58.9。

发布证据虽不完整，但可以具体核验。RM Hub 仓库包含一个 2.16 GB JSONL，viewer 显示 472,769 行，字段为 messages、images 和 positive。Agent 仓库包含一个 74.35 MB 的 UI-Genie JSONL、按 2,208 个轨迹目录组织的 16,693 张截图，以及另一个 155.55 MB 的 AMEX_Agent_34K.jsonl，但数据卡没有解释它与命名发布的关系。NeurIPS 补充包只含 3 条示范轨迹的截图、XML 状态与 history JSON，属于示例材料，不是完整构造包。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The main contribution is a data engine that joins a GUI-specific binary step/outcome verifier with iterative collection. It uses cheap structural checks to seed reward data, adds controlled task-level corruption and RM-targeted hard negatives, and then reuses the verifier for beam-search control, outcome filtering, and continuation-based step relabeling. Agent data and reward data are therefore co-produced instead of being prepared once in isolation.

The useful novelty is the explicit connection among corruption operators, verifier training, exploration, and accepted SFT records. It is not evidence that the verifier is ground truth, that synthetic negatives cover natural agent failures, or that the loop is self-correcting. The same RM influences search, acceptance, and later labels, so systematic errors can be amplified across generations.

本文的主要贡献是一套把 GUI 专用二元步级/结果级验证器与迭代式数据采集连接起来的数据引擎。它先用低成本结构规则初始化奖励数据，再加入受控的任务级破坏和针对 RM 的困难负例，随后把验证器同时用于 beam-search 控制、结果筛选和基于续跑的步骤重标注。这样，agent 数据与奖励数据在同一闭环中共同产生，而不是分别一次性制备。

真正有用的新意，是把破坏算子、验证器训练、探索与最终接受的 SFT 记录明确串联起来。这并不意味着验证器就是真值，也不意味着合成负例覆盖了自然发生的 agent 失败，更不能说明闭环一定会自我纠错。同一个 RM 同时影响搜索、接纳与后续标签，因此系统性错误可能跨代放大。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The central risk is verifier feedback. A false-positive completion can admit a bad trajectory to SFT, label its steps positive, and shape the next agent; a false-negative can discard valid alternatives. Controlled truncation, cross-task substitution, and redundant continuation may also leave detectable artifacts that differ from organic agent mistakes. The custom RM benchmark shares source families and corruption logic with training, so generalization to unseen apps and failure modes remains uncertain.

Published counts and units do not line up cleanly. The paper/name uses 517K RM examples, but the current viewer exposes 472,769 rows. “Agent-16k” is described loosely as trajectories in prose/README, while Table 1 and the file layout support 2,208 trajectories and roughly 16K step examples. The Agent repository also mixes in AMEX_Agent_34K.jsonl without documenting whether it is upstream context, a training dependency, or part of the release. There is no generation manifest or record-level acceptance provenance to reconcile these differences.

Reproduction is incomplete. The repository supplies agent SFT and AndroidControl evaluation scripts, but not RM training or the iterative generation pipeline; AndroidLab and Android Arena evaluation scripts are still marked for future release, the 72B checkpoint is not released, and there are no tags or GitHub releases. Exact exploration temperature, stopping policy, task budgets, emulator/app versions, account state, and immutable environment snapshots are unknown. Dynamic interfaces make coordinate replay and success predicates non-stationary.

Privacy, rights, and split controls are also unresolved. Screenshots and typed text can reveal accounts, notifications, contacts, queries, or third-party content. The HF cards label the datasets MIT, but that label does not establish rights to every upstream screenshot, app interface, or user state. The repository's root README claims MIT while no root license file exists and bundled ms-swift carries Apache-2.0. No verified per-record consent/redaction log, source license matrix, deduplication report, or app/task/account leakage analysis is available.

The paper itself notes suboptimal RM rewards, inability to guarantee fully correct trajectories, and high computation/carbon cost. Evaluation confirms substantial remaining gaps: Android Arena hard and multi-frame-query success is 0.0 for the reported 7B agent, and test-time reward selection does not consistently improve hard cases.

最核心的风险是验证器反馈。一次假阳性的完成判断可能让错误轨迹进入 SFT、把其中步骤标成正例，并进一步影响下一代 agent；假阴性则会丢弃有效替代方案。提前截断、跨任务替换和完成后冗余续跑还可能留下易识别的人工痕迹，与自然发生的 agent 错误不同。自建 RM benchmark 与训练共享数据来源和破坏逻辑，因此对新 app 与新失败模式的泛化仍不确定。

发布规模和计量单位并不完全一致。论文与名称使用 517K RM 样本，但当前 viewer 只暴露 472,769 行。“Agent-16k”在正文或 README 中有时被宽泛描述为轨迹，而表 1 与文件布局支持的是 2,208 条轨迹和约 16K 个步级样本。Agent 仓库还混放了 AMEX_Agent_34K.jsonl，却没有说明它是上游背景、训练依赖还是发布组成。由于缺少按代次的 manifest 和记录级接纳来源，这些差异无法被完整对账。

复现链条并不完整。仓库给出了 agent SFT 与 AndroidControl 评测脚本，但没有 RM 训练或迭代生成流程；AndroidLab 与 Android Arena 的评测脚本仍标为未来发布，72B checkpoint 未发布，仓库也没有 tag 或 GitHub release。探索温度、停止策略、任务预算、模拟器/app 版本、账户状态与不可变环境快照均未知。动态界面会让坐标重放和成功判据随时间漂移。

隐私、权利与数据划分也未解决。截图和输入文本可能暴露账户、通知、联系人、查询或第三方内容。HF 数据卡把数据标为 MIT，但这一标签不能证明每张上游截图、app 界面或用户状态都具备再分发权。仓库根 README 声称 MIT，却没有根目录 LICENSE；内嵌的 ms-swift 则使用 Apache-2.0。当前没有经过核验的逐记录同意/脱敏日志、来源许可矩阵、去重报告或 app/任务/账户泄漏分析。

论文自身也承认 RM 可能给出次优奖励、无法保证轨迹完全正确，并带来较高计算与碳成本。实验还显示明显缺口：报告中的 7B agent 在 Android Arena 的 hard 和 multi-frame-query 子集上成功率为 0.0，测试时奖励筛选也没有稳定改善困难样本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the open-release construction-recipes track, UI-Genie is useful as a staged design to compare: seed labels from rules, manufacture several negative types, train a multimodal verifier, use it in bounded search, verify outcomes, recover step labels with continuations, and alternate RM/agent updates. Researchers can study which stage contributes new coverage versus merely recycles the verifier's preferences.

The RM release can support binary GUI reward modeling, history-length studies, corruption detection, calibration, and evaluation of cross-source transfer. The Agent release can support step-level mobile-action SFT, trajectory reconstruction by directory identifier, and analyses of task progress/action-description formatting. Because the public JSONL is step-oriented, users should reconstruct episodes explicitly rather than treating rows as independent trajectories.

Safe reuse should pin Hub commit SHAs and the repository commit; preserve source, episode, step, generation, corruption operator, verifier version/score, and acceptance reason in a new manifest; separate AMEX from UI-Genie-generated records; audit screenshots and typed content; and freeze emulator/app/account state. A new project should validate completion with independent executable checks or human audits, measure verifier calibration by source/app/difficulty, and keep a held-out app/task split before feeding selected trajectories back into training.

The release is not a turnkey reproduction of the full loop. It is best treated as partial data plus an auditable recipe whose missing generation, RM-training, dynamic-environment, licensing, and lineage components must be supplied before deployment or strong causal claims.

对“开放发布的数据构造配方”这条 track 而言，UI-Genie 提供了一套可分阶段比较的设计：先用规则获得种子标签，再制造多类负例、训练多模态验证器、把它放入有界搜索、核验任务结果、用续跑恢复步骤标签，并交替更新 RM 与 agent。研究者可以据此判断，哪些环节真正扩展了数据覆盖，哪些环节只是重复验证器已有偏好。

RM 发布可用于二元 GUI 奖励建模、历史长度研究、破坏检测、校准和跨来源迁移评估。Agent 发布可用于步级移动动作 SFT、依据目录标识重建轨迹，以及分析任务进度与 action description 的格式。由于公开 JSONL 以步骤为单位，复用者应显式重建 episode，不能把每一行当作独立轨迹。

稳妥复用时，应固定 Hub commit SHA 与仓库 commit；在新 manifest 中保留来源、episode、step、代次、破坏算子、验证器版本/分数和接纳原因；把 AMEX 与 UI-Genie 生成记录分开；审计截图与输入内容；冻结模拟器、app 和账户状态。新项目还应使用独立可执行检查或人工审计来核验完成度，按来源/app/难度测量验证器校准，并在把筛选轨迹回灌训练前保留 app/任务级测试集。

这个发布并不是完整闭环的一键复现包。更合适的定位是“部分数据 + 可审计配方”；在用于部署或提出强因果结论之前，仍需补齐生成、RM 训练、动态环境、许可和逐记录 lineage。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read “RM-517k” as a rounded paper/release label; the current Hub viewer reports 472,769 rows.
  • Read “Agent-16k” as step/example scale: Table 1 and the release layout indicate 2,208 trajectories and 16,693 screenshots.
  • Separate rule labels, controlled-corruption labels, RM-mined hard negatives, RM outcome judgments, and continuation-derived step labels; one RM controls search, acceptance, and later labels, so evaluate error amplification across generations.
  • “Without manual annotation” does not remove human source demonstrations or manually crafted long-horizon task prompts.
  • The published code covers agent SFT and AndroidControl evaluation, not the full data engine or RM training; treat benchmark gains as model evidence, not proof that every released datum is correct.
  • Audit the unexplained AMEX_Agent_34K.jsonl, privacy/redaction, upstream rights, split leakage, environment drift, and legal reusability before reuse.

• 将“RM-517k”理解为论文/发布中的取整名称；当前 Hub viewer 报告 472,769 行。
  • 将“Agent-16k”理解为步/样本规模；表 1 与发布目录显示 2,208 条轨迹和 16,693 张截图。
  • 区分规则标签、受控破坏标签、RM 挖掘的困难负例、RM 结果判断与续跑步骤标签；同一个 RM 同时控制搜索、接纳和后续标签，因此应评估错误是否跨代放大。
  • “Without manual annotation”并没有消除人工源示范，也没有消除人工编写的长程任务提示。
  • 发布代码覆盖 agent SFT 与 AndroidControl 评测，不覆盖完整数据引擎或 RM 训练；benchmark 增益是模型证据，不能证明每条发布数据都正确。
  • 复用前审计未解释的 AMEX_Agent_34K.jsonl、隐私/脱敏、上游权利、划分泄漏、环境漂移与合法复用条件。

Android mobile GUIs explored through an executable action interface; AndroidLab and Android Arena provide dynamic evaluation environments
Rule checks for action type, coordinates, and typed-text semantics; controlled corruptions; mined hard negatives; and UI-Genie-RM binary step/task judgments

Qwen2.5-VL-7B for UI-Genie-RM and the iterative agent; final agents are trained at 3B, 7B, and 72B scales
Rule-verified source actions, environment outcomes, DeepSeek-V3 task/action-description generation, and the prior-round UI-Genie-RM
Current-round UI-Genie agent with reward-guided beam search
